paper_title: Stochastic fluctuations of bosonic dark matter
coupling_convention: GeV^-1 (gaNN as gradient coupling, paper's convention)
notes: This is a methodology/reinterpretation paper showing that stochastic VULF amplitude fluctuations relax previously published constraints by factors of ~3-10. It does not present a new measured limit; it rescales existing constraints (CASPEr-ZULF, nEDM, dilaton clock experiments). The exclusion plots (Fig 3, Fig 4) show corrected constraints for axion-nucleon coupling gaNN and dilaton couplings, but no numerical (mass, coupling) tables are provided in the text.
